# Exceptions reference

<!-- Generated by `bun run docs:api` (scripts/gen-exceptions-reference.ts) from the exported exceptions, their JSDoc and `statusOf`. Do not edit by hand: change the JSDoc in `src/` or the handling in the script, and regenerate. -->

Every exception afora exports (72), by layer, and the names it raises without a class. Each one is an `Exception` with a `layer`, a `name`, a `source` and `details`; [Exceptions](../exceptions.md) explains the model, `trace` and `guard`.

**Status** is what `statusOf` gives, and so what the HTTP providers and the `websocket` sink answer, as problem+json ([Outputs](../outputs.md)): 400 for invalid input (and any exception whose `details.issues` is a list), 401, 403, 404 and 409 by name, and 500 for the rest. Two settings change it: an exception listed in the operation's `errors` (`useCaseOf({ errors })`, `throws` of a standard use case) answers 422 instead of 500, and the `statuses` option of an output maps any name to the status you choose.

**Catch** an exception with `error instanceof Class` when it is thrown as it is, or with `error.is(Class)` (also `is("Name")`) when it may come wrapped by an upper layer.

## Schema

Layer `ExceptionLayers.Schema` (`"schema"`).

| Exception           | When it is thrown                                                                          | Status | How to handle it                                                                                |
| ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `InvalidJsonSchema` | A schema given to `jsonOf` or `checkJsonSchema` that is not a JSON Schema (draft 2020-12). | 500    | Fix the schema; for a schema loaded at runtime, check it when it is saved, not when it is used. |

## Property

Layer `ExceptionLayers.Property` (`"property"`).

| Exception                | When it is thrown                                                                                                                                                 | Status | How to handle it                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| ------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `InvalidJsonData`        | JSON data that its JSON Schema rejects, or that is not JSON at all, as `checkJsonSchema` finds it; `details.issues` says where and why (so `statusOf` gives 400). | 400    | Invalid input from the caller. An output answers it as a 400 problem+json with the `issues`; in your own code, read `details.issues`.                                                                               |
| `InvalidPropertyValue`   | A property got a value its rules reject; `source` is the property name.                                                                                           | 500    | Thrown by a property built on its own. A record passes it up to the `Record` layer with the key in `details`, and a use case reports it as an issue; use `safeParse` to collect every issue instead of catching it. |
| `PasswordHasherRequired` | No password hasher can run here; call `configure({ hasher })`.                                                                                                    | 500    | Call `configure({ hasher })` at start on a runtime without argon2 (browsers, Workers, Node < 24.7). See [Runtime](../runtime.md).                                                                                   |
| `PropertyRequired`       | A required property got `undefined`; `source` is the property name.                                                                                               | 500    | Thrown by a property built on its own (`new Email(undefined)`). A record, a blueprint or a use case reports it as a `required` issue instead; use `safeParse` to collect it.                                        |
| `SyncVerifyUnsupported`  | The hasher in use cannot verify without waiting; use `verify` instead.                                                                                            | 500    | Use `await password.verify(input)`, or configure a hasher with `verifySync`.                                                                                                                                        |

## Blueprint

Layer `ExceptionLayers.Blueprint` (`"blueprint"`).

| Exception                     | When it is thrown                                                                    | Status | How to handle it                                                                                                            |
| ----------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `InvalidBlueprintVariant`     | `variantOf` was given something it cannot make a field of; `reason` says what.       | 500    | A mistake in the code, raised when the module loads or the declaration is first used: fix the declaration. Do not catch it. |
| `ReservedBlueprintKey`        | A plugin declares a key the blueprint context reserves; `source` is the plugin name. | 500    | A mistake in the code, raised when the module loads or the declaration is first used: fix the declaration. Do not catch it. |
| `UndeclaredBlueprintProperty` | A blueprint picks a key that no plugin provides.                                     | 500    | A mistake in the code, raised when the module loads or the declaration is first used: fix the declaration. Do not catch it. |

## Record

Layer `ExceptionLayers.Record` (`"record"`).

| Exception                  | When it is thrown                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | Status | How to handle it                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `IncompatibleRecordPlugin` | The plugin of a catalog does not satisfy a reference to it: an older or incompatible version, keys or members it no longer has, or a descriptor that is not one; `source` is the plugin name, `reason` says which.                                                                      | 500    | Install the plugin version the catalog reference asks for, or update the reference.                                                                                                                                  |
| `InvalidRecordDeclaration` | `recordOf` or `entityOf` got an option it cannot use, as a `name` that is not an identifier.                                                                                                                                                                                            | 500    | A mistake in the code, raised when the module loads or the declaration is first used: fix the declaration. Do not catch it.                                                                                          |
| `InvalidRecordPlugin`      | `recordPluginOf` was given what cannot be a plugin: a class not made by `recordOf` (an entity included, as plugins have no identity), an invalid name or version, or a class declaring a member of every record (`toJSON`, `set`...); `source` is the plugin name, `reason` says which. | 500    | A mistake in the code, raised when the module loads or the declaration is first used: fix the declaration. Do not catch it.                                                                                          |
| `InvalidRecordValue`       | A key of a record got a value its field rejects; `source` is the record name, `key` and `errors` are those of the first issue, and `issues` has all of them (not enumerable, so it stays out of logs and comparisons).                                                                  | 400    | Invalid input from the caller. An output answers it as a 400 problem+json with the `issues`; in your own code, read `details.issues`. Use `Record.safeParse` where invalid input is expected.                        |
| `RecordPluginConflict`     | A plugin adds a key or a member that the record, or another of its plugins, already has, or two different plugins share a name; `source` is the record name, `plugin` the plugin adding `key`, `owner` who has it.                                                                      | 500    | A mistake in the code, raised when the module loads or the declaration is first used: fix the declaration. Do not catch it.                                                                                          |
| `ReservedRecordKey`        | A blueprint key takes the name of a member of the record; `source` is the record name.                                                                                                                                                                                                  | 500    | A mistake in the code, raised when the module loads or the declaration is first used: fix the declaration. Do not catch it. Rename the key or the member.                                                            |
| `UndeclaredRecordProperty` | A record is given a key its blueprint does not declare, in its value or by `set`; `key` is its path, e.g. `address.extra`, and `source` the record name. `issues` has every issue found of a value, this one first (not enumerable).                                                    | 400    | Invalid input from the caller. An output answers it as a 400 problem+json with the `issues`; in your own code, read `details.issues`. The value is rejected, never trimmed: drop the key before building the record. |
| `UnknownRecordPlugin`      | A catalog has no plugin of the name it is asked for; `source` is the catalog.                                                                                                                                                                                                           | 500    | A mistake in the code, raised when the module loads or the declaration is first used: fix the declaration. Do not catch it.                                                                                          |

## Entity

Layer `ExceptionLayers.Entity` (`"entity"`).

| Exception                    | When it is thrown                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | Status | How to handle it                                                                                                                           |
| ---------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `DeletedEntity`              | A destroyed entity is changed, or destroyed again; `source` is the entity name.                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | 500    | Check `entity.deletedAt` (or reload the entity) before changing it.                                                                        |
| `ImmutableEntityKey`         | A key of the identity of an entity is changed by `set`, or listed in `change`; the entity keeps it. `source` is the entity name.                                                                                                                                                                     | 500    | A mistake in the calling code, not something a caller can cause: fix the call. The identity keys are set by the entity and the repository. |
| `InvalidEntityExpiry`        | The `expires` option of an entity is invalid: `at` names no date key of its blueprint, `after` is not a duration of positive numbers, or the entity builder has no `expiresAt` field; `source` is the entity name.                                                                                   | 500    | A mistake in the code, raised when the module loads or the declaration is first used: fix the declaration. Do not catch it.                |
| `InvalidEntitySchemaVersion` | The schema evolution options of an entity are invalid: `schemaVersion` is not a positive integer, a step of `upgrade` is not a function or reaches a version outside `2..schemaVersion`, or `previousNames` holds something that cannot name a record, or its own name; `source` is the entity name. | 500    | A mistake in the code, raised when the module loads or the declaration is first used: fix the declaration. Do not catch it.                |
| `ReservedEntityKey`          | A blueprint key of an entity takes the name of a key of its identity (`id`, `createdAt`, `updatedAt`, `deletedAt`) or of a member of the entity; `source` is the entity name.                                                                                                                        | 500    | A mistake in the code, raised when the module loads or the declaration is first used: fix the declaration. Do not catch it.                |

## UseCase

Layer `ExceptionLayers.UseCase` (`"use-case"`).

| Exception                    | When it is thrown                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | Status | How to handle it                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| ---------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `IncompatibleUseCasePlugin`  | The use case plugin of a catalog does not satisfy the version asked for; `source` is the plugin name.                                                                                                                                                                                                 | 500    | Install the plugin version the catalog reference asks for, or update the reference.                                                                                                               |
| `InvalidUseCaseDeclaration`  | A use case, or a decorator of one, is declared with what it cannot use; `reason` says what.                                                                                                                                                                                                           | 500    | A mistake in the code, raised when the module loads or the declaration is first used: fix the declaration. Do not catch it.                                                                       |
| `InvalidUseCaseDependencies` | The overrides given to `execute` name a dependency the use case does not declare, or give the wrong kind of value for one; or a dependency was called after `execute` ended.                                                                                                                          | 500    | A mistake in the calling code, not something a caller can cause: fix the call.                                                                                                                    |
| `InvalidUseCasePlugin`       | `useCasePluginOf` or `useCaseCatalogOf` was given what cannot be a plugin or a catalog: an invalid name or version, no `compile`, two plugins with one name; or a plugin was called with something that is not a repository or with options that are not a plain object. `source` is the plugin name. | 500    | A mistake in the code, raised when the module loads or the declaration is first used: fix the declaration. Do not catch it.                                                                       |
| `InvalidUseCaseStep`         | A step of a use case is invalid: at declaration (`useCaseOf({ steps })`), or while the steps run (a `change` or `invoke` on something that is not a record or has no such member, or `args` that a `run`'s `params` reject). `details.index` is the position of the step.                             | 400    | A mistake in the code, raised when the module loads or the declaration is first used: fix the declaration. Do not catch it. `details.index` is the step.                                          |
| `UnknownUseCasePlugin`       | A catalog has no use case plugin of that name; `source` is `catalog`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | 500    | A mistake in the code, raised when the module loads or the declaration is first used: fix the declaration. Do not catch it.                                                                       |
| `UseCaseAlreadyExecuted`     | `execute` was called twice on one instance of a use case, which runs only once.                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | 500    | A mistake in the calling code, not something a caller can cause: fix the call. Create a new instance for each call (`app.run` and commands do).                                                   |
| `UseCaseEntityConflict`      | What a use case made by a plugin throws for an entity that already exists, unless given another error.                                                                                                                                                                                                | 409    | An output answers 409. Pass your own error in the use case's options to name it in your domain.                                                                                                   |
| `UseCaseEntityNotFound`      | What a use case made by a plugin throws for an entity it did not find, unless given another error.                                                                                                                                                                                                    | 404    | An output answers 404. Pass your own error in the use case's options to name it in your domain.                                                                                                   |
| `UseCaseInvalidCredentials`  | What a use case made by a plugin throws for credentials that do not match, unless given another error.                                                                                                                                                                                                | 401    | An output answers 401. Do not tell the caller which part did not match.                                                                                                                           |
| `UseCaseUnavailable`         | A use case plugin cannot make its use case for a repository: the repository lacks an action, the entity lacks a record plugin, or an option names what the entity does not have. `source` is the plugin name.                                                                                         | 500    | A mistake in the code, raised when the module loads or the declaration is first used: fix the declaration. Do not catch it. Add the action to the repository, or the record plugin to the entity. |

## Repository

Layer `ExceptionLayers.Repository` (`"repository"`).

| Exception                          | When it is thrown                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | Status | How to handle it                                                                                                                                         |
| ---------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `InvalidRepositoryCursor`          | `findCursor` got an `after` that is not a cursor it gave, or one made for another `orderBy`; `source` is the repository name. Its `issues` name the `after` of the query, so an output answers it as invalid input.                                                                                                 | 400    | Invalid input from the caller. An output answers it as a 400 problem+json with the `issues`; in your own code, read `details.issues`.                    |
| `InvalidRepositoryData`            | A provider gave a value its entity rejects; `source` is the repository name.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | 500    | A stored row does not fit the entity (a migration is missing, or another writer). Fix the data or add a schema evolution step; the cause says which key. |
| `InvalidRepositoryDeclaration`     | `repositoryOf` got something other than an entity, actions and a provider.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | 500    | A mistake in the code, raised when the module loads or the declaration is first used: fix the declaration. Do not catch it.                              |
| `InvalidRepositoryEntity`          | A method of a repository got a value that is not an entity of it.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | 500    | A mistake in the calling code, not something a caller can cause: fix the call. Pass an instance of the repository's entity.                              |
| `InvalidRepositoryIncrement`       | `increment` got deltas it cannot apply: a key that is not a number in the `change` list of the entity, or a value that is not a finite number. Its `issues` name each, so an output answers it as invalid input.                                                                                                    | 400    | Invalid input from the caller. An output answers it as a 400 problem+json with the `issues`; in your own code, read `details.issues`.                    |
| `InvalidRepositoryQuery`           | A query contains unsupported keys, ordering or pagination.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | 500    | Fix the query: only declared keys, a supported ordering and pagination. When the query comes from a caller, validate it first.                           |
| `InvalidStoredSchemaVersion`       | A stored row holds a schema version (`SCHEMA_VERSION_KEY`) that is not a positive integer, or that is above the `schemaVersion` of its entity (it was written by newer code), or an `upgrade` step did not give an object. `source` is the repository name; reads throw it as the cause of `InvalidRepositoryData`. | 500    | A row written by newer code, or a broken `upgrade` step: deploy the newer code, or fix the step.                                                         |
| `RepositoryConcurrencyConflict`    | `update` of a versioned entity found another version stored than the one it read: someone else wrote it in between (optimistic concurrency). `actual` is the stored version, when the provider knows it; `source` is the repository name. An output answers it with 409.                                            | 409    | An output answers 409. Reload the entity, apply the change again and retry, or ask the caller to.                                                        |
| `RepositoryEntityNotFound`         | No entity of the id was found; `source` is the repository name.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | 404    | An output answers 404.                                                                                                                                   |
| `RepositoryUniqueViolation`        | Another entity holds the value of a unique key; `source` is the repository name.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | 409    | An output answers 409; `details.key` names the unique key.                                                                                               |
| `RepositoryUsedOutsideApplication` | A repository declared at module level was called after an application bound it to its provider: the calls of the application go through `app.repositories.<key>`, its use cases (`app.run`, `app.useCase`) or a repository given to `execute`; `source` is the repository name.                                     | 500    | Call it through the application: `app.repositories.<key>`, its use cases, or a repository given to `execute`.                                            |

## Environment

Layer `ExceptionLayers.Environment` (`"environment"`).

| Exception                       | When it is thrown                                                                                                                 | Status | How to handle it                                                                                                                                                                  |
| ------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `InvalidApplicationEnvironment` | `app.start()` found environments whose variables are missing or rejected; `details.environments` gives the keys of each, by name. | 500    | Raised by `app.start()`, before the application serves anything: fix the configuration or the deployment, and let the process fail. `details.environments` lists the keys to set. |
| `InvalidEnvironment`            | A variable of the environment is missing or rejected by its blueprint.                                                            | 500    | Set or fix the variable named in the message; validate environments at start (`app.start()`) so it fails before serving.                                                          |

Layer `ExceptionLayers.Event` (`"event"`).

## Command

Layer `ExceptionLayers.Command` (`"command"`).

| Exception                   | When it is thrown                                                                                                                                                                | Status | How to handle it                                                                                                                      |
| --------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `CommandEventFailed`        | An event handler failed after the call succeeded (and, with a transaction, committed). `handled` events ran before the failure and `remaining` events after it were not handled. | 500    | The call itself succeeded (and committed): do not retry it. Handle or retry the `remaining` events, e.g. from an outbox.              |
| `InvalidCommandContext`     | The context of a call does not fit the context blueprint of the command.                                                                                                         | 400    | Invalid input from the caller. An output answers it as a 400 problem+json with the `issues`; in your own code, read `details.issues`. |
| `InvalidCommandDeclaration` | `commandOf` got a setting it cannot use; `details.reason` says which.                                                                                                            | 500    | A mistake in the code, raised when the module loads or the declaration is first used: fix the declaration. Do not catch it.           |
| `InvalidCommandEnvironment` | The `env` of a call holds a key no environment of the command declares, or a value its blueprint rejects. It is configuration, not input.                                        | 500    | Configuration, not input (an output answers 500): fix the `env` given to the call or the environment blueprint.                       |
| `UnknownCommandOperation`   | A command was asked for an operation it does not declare.                                                                                                                        | 404    | An output answers 404. In your own code, call an operation the command declares.                                                      |

Do not catch it. Register it in the application.                                                             |
| `UnregisteredUseCaseDependency`    | A dependency of a use case of the application (a use case, repository or environment) is not registered in it.                                                                                                                                                                                                         | 500    | A mistake in the code, raised when the module loads or the declaration is first used: fix the declaration. Do not catch it. Register it in the application.                                                             |

## Output

Layer `ExceptionLayers.Output` (`"output"`).

| Exception                                                           | When it is thrown                                                                                                                                                                                                       | Status | How to handle it                                                                                                                                               |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `DuplicateOperation`                                                | Two operations of an output share an id.                                                                                                                                                                                | 500    | A mistake in the code, raised when the module loads or the declaration is first used: fix the declaration. Do not catch it. Give each operation its own id.    |
| `Forbidden`                                                         | The caller is authenticated but may not call the operation: it lacks a scope the `access` of the operation asks for (`details.reason` is `"scope"`, with the missing `scopes`), or is not the owner (`"owner"`). A 403. | 403    | An output answers 403. In your own code, check the scopes or the owner before calling, or let it through.                                                      |
| `InvalidJwtOptions` (from `@afora/core/experimental`, experimental) | `jwtOf` got options it cannot use, or its secret is missing; `details.reason` says what.                                                                                                                                | 500    | A mistake in the code, raised when the module loads or the declaration is first used: fix the declaration. Do not catch it. Set the secret in the environment. |
| `InvalidOpenAPIModel`                                               | `toOpenAPI` is given something that is not a field: a property, blueprint, list, record or entity.                                                                                                                      | 500    | A mistake in the code, raised when the module loads or the declaration is first used: fix the declaration. Do not catch it.                                    |
| `InvalidOutputStage`                                                | `outputOf`, an operation patch or a stage got something it cannot use; `details.reason` says what.                                                                                                                      | 500    | A mistake in the code, raised when the module loads or the declaration is first used: fix the declaration. Do not catch it.                                    |
| `Unauthenticated`                                                   | An operation that declares its `access` was called without an authenticated caller: no credentials, or ones that were not accepted. A 401.                                                                              | 401    | An output answers 401.                                                                                                                                         |

## Raised without a class

These names come as a plain `Exception`: check them with `error.is("Name")` or `error.name`.

| Name                     | Layer      | When it is thrown                                                                                                                    | Status | How to handle it                                                                                                                      |
| ------------------------ | ---------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `InvalidUseCaseInput`    | `use-case` | The input of a call does not fit the input blueprint of the use case.                                                                | 400    | Invalid input from the caller. An output answers it as a 400 problem+json with the `issues`; in your own code, read `details.issues`. |
| `InvalidUseCaseContext`  | `use-case` | The context of a call does not fit the context blueprint of the use case.                                                            | 400    | Invalid input from the caller. An output answers it as a 400 problem+json with the `issues`; in your own code, read `details.issues`. |
| `InvalidUseCaseResponse` | `use-case` | What a use case returns does not fit its response blueprint.                                                                         | 400    | A mistake in the use case: fix what it returns. It carries `issues`, so `statusOf` gives 400; map it with `statuses` to answer 500.   |
| `UnexpectedError`        | `use-case` | An error that is not an `Exception`, wrapped by `Exception.from` (by `guard`, a use case or a command); the original is its `cause`. | 500    | An output answers 500 and logs it. Find the cause and throw a declared exception instead.                                             |
